selection.override_reason: Composite rank preferred K-Means k=3, but its largest segment (71% of customers) merges cash-advance-only borrowers with active purchasers. k=4 splits exactly that segment, keeps the other two segments almost unchanged, sits at the inertia elbow, and is just as stable (ARI 0.99).

Cash-Advance Borrowers.description: Cash-Advance Borrowers (21.9% of customers): median balance 1,754, median purchases 0 (purchase frequency 0.00), median cash advance 1,366, median credit limit 3,000, median payments 820, 0% pay >=50% of the time in full.
Cash-Advance Borrowers.assumption: Likely a higher-risk and higher-fee-income group, since cash advances usually carry fees and higher rates. This dataset has no fee, interest or delinquency fields, so this is NOT verified.
Cash-Advance Borrowers.action: Offer a lower-rate balance-transfer or personal-loan product; nudge toward everyday purchases with card rewards; monitor utilisation for early-warning review (do not auto-restrict on this label alone).

Low-Activity Light Users.description: Low-Activity Light Users (13.3% of customers): median balance 23, median purchases 143 (purchase frequency 0.17), median cash advance 0, median credit limit 2,700, median payments 326, 8% pay >=50% of the time in full.
Low-Activity Light Users.assumption: Probably low revenue today and a possible attrition risk, but also the largest headroom for activation. Unverified.
Low-Activity Light Users.action: Activation campaign: first-purchase bonuses, spend-threshold rewards, merchant partnerships; review whether the card is still the right product (annual-fee-free tier) before spending on acquisition-style offers.

Frequent Full-Payers.description: Frequent Full-Payers (14.4% of customers): median balance 90, median purchases 916 (purchase frequency 0.92), median cash advance 0, median credit limit 4,000, median payments 1,100, 91% pay >=50% of the time in full.
Frequent Full-Payers.assumption: Likely low interest income but high interchange (swipe-fee) value and low credit risk. Unverified - no revenue data.
Frequent Full-Payers.action: Retention and loyalty: premium rewards tier, limit increases, installment-plan promotions for big-ticket items; avoid interest-based offers that do not match their behaviour.

Active Balance-Carriers.description: Active Balance-Carriers (50.4% of customers): median balance 1,180, median purchases 677 (purchase frequency 0.75), median cash advance 0, median credit limit 3,500, median payments 969, 0% pay >=50% of the time in full.
Active Balance-Carriers.assumption: Likely the main interest-income group, with moderate risk that depends on utilisation and repayment trends. Unverified.
Active Balance-Carriers.action: Cross-sell installment plans and balance-management tools; reward on-time payments; watch the sub-group with payments below the minimum due for hardship outreach.
